comment: Absolutely incredible dining experience. The ribeye was cooked to perfection and the service was impeccable.
Best tiramisu I've had outside of Italy. Will definitely be coming back.
Great ambiance and food. The truffle tagliatelle was divine. Took a star off for the wait time.
The spicy seafood stew is a must-try! Bold flavors and generous portions.
Lovely place for date night. The carbonara was authentic and delicious.
Food was good but the restaurant was quite loud on a Saturday night. Hard to have a conversation.
The Korean BBQ short ribs blew my mind. Perfect blend of sweet and spicy. The staff were so friendly.
Excellent cocktails. The mojito was refreshing and well-balanced. Food portions could be slightly larger.
We ordered delivery and everything arrived hot and fresh. The bruschetta trio was a highlight.
Celebrated our anniversary here. The chocolate lava cake was the perfect ending to a perfect evening.
Pan-seared salmon was perfectly cooked with a beautiful crispy skin. Great wine selection too.
The herb-crusted chicken was a bit dry. The sides were excellent though, especially the truffle fries.
